Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. panels.description: Browse the latest 10 launches across All pipelines by start time. Workflow and Run Type filter the list. The dashboard time picker does not filter this table. Running means a recorded start without a terminal event, not a live health probe. REPORT MISSING means no final report is available. Defaults All / All / All and run_id=- select no exact run. Effective refresh: 60s; timezone: browser.

panels.title: Inspect Recent Runs (last 10)
panels.description: BROWSE — Last 10 launches by started_at across the selected pipeline scope, after Workflow and Run Type filters. The dashboard time picker does not filter this table. Start time comes from ledger/report identity, with explicitly recorded manifest-created fallback; never file mtime. One row is one launch. Running is the last recorded lifecycle state, not live-process proof. REPORT MISSING distinguishes launches without a persisted report. Click a Run cell to select and mark that run, binding Workflow, Pipeline, Run Type and Run ID from that row. Pipeline and Workflow belong to each row. Older runs: use the Run ID catalog. limit=10 shows all ten rows together without pagination. VALID EMPTY means no matching launches; TREE_MISSING / LAYOUT_UNHEALTHY / IDENTITY_UNHEALTHY means a report bind failure. Backend failures are QUERY ERROR, not empty data. Run python scripts/ops/runtime/docker/verify_report_bind.py to diagnose the report bind. The matching SELECTED RUN row is marked; browse is not an exact-run snapshot. Report opens the row file in a new tab: Markdown when present, otherwise JSON. REPORT MISSING opens an explicit not-found response; it does not imply a persisted file. Find Run ID searches exact UUID before the ten-row limit. Duration needs valid start/end. Event age is the last ledger event for unfinished runs, not a heartbeat. Inspect a Run cell to copy its full UUID. DUAL-STATUS · Column Processing is run-report execution state (processing_status). Trust/evidence verdict is a separate axis — open 1. Trust for the selected Run ID; do not treat Processing success as trust OK.

panels.title: Inspect Selected Run Domains
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence.
